updates.title: Bind variables via scan and always use $var after binding
updates.rationale: Demonstrates correct variable scan binding, followed by variable usage. Avoids unbound variable usage and ensures scan target is concrete.

updates.title: Every step advances the main goal directly
updates.rationale: Illustrates each plan action contributing directly to the stated intent, with no missing required actions or extraneous steps.

updates.title: Minimal direct path: No redundant movement or checks
updates.rationale: Shows how to complete a basic obtain/consume with the smallest sensible action set, avoiding inefficiencies.

updates.title: Precondition checked: Near before take/use/inspect
updates.rationale: Demonstrates that before take/use/inspect, agent always ensures 'near' precondition, as enforced with a while loop.
